summary: Temporary elevated cloud IAM + loaner laptop MFA exception for summer intern dataset onboarding
description: Issue summary: HR has scheduled a summer intern (contractor intern) to join the Data Platform team on 2026-03-15 for a 10-week engagement. The internship scope requires ingesting sensitive internal datasets for data-cleaning and metadata tagging. Impact: Without temporary ability to create dataset-level service accounts and access GCS staging buckets, onboarding work will be delayed by 1-2 weeks and the data team will need to rework the training plan. Request: Approve a controlled policy exception that allows the intern a time-limited cloud IAM role (dataset-stager-temp) and permit enrollment on a loaner laptop with a temporarily attenuated MFA enforcement policy for the first 48 hours to complete initial device provisioning. We need explicit guards: timebox to 2026-06-01, audit logging enabled, service-account impersonation rather than long-lived keys, and Security & HR sign-off.
actions_requested: 1) Approval from Security for time-limited IAM role and temporary MFA policy waiver on loaner device. 2) Create temporary service account 'int-data-stager-555432' with role dataset-stager-temp and bind to intern identity for 2026-03-15 to 2026-06-01. 3) Issue a loaner laptop with full disk encryption and endpoint management; allow enrollment without company MFA for first 48 hours with audit flag. 4) Ensure logs are exported to sec-audit bucket and alerts are set for any privilege escalation. 5) HR to collect intern agreement acknowledging data handling policies.
investigation_notes:
- Verified HR request in #hr-onboarding thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/CHX12345/p167XXX
- Reviewed existing policy: 'Temporary Elevated Access' runbook (Confluence: /display/SEC/Temp+Elevated+Access). Current runbook requires Security OTP enrollment and manager approval; loaner MFA waiver is non-standard.
- Checked previous similar tickets: INT-11856, INT-17430 for precedent on loaner devices and temporary VPN rules.
- Security note: prefer service account impersonation and short-lived tokens (STS) over user role assignment.
- Endpoint team: loaner HPE-DEL-202 has MDM profile ready; can defer strict MFA enforcement via conditional policy for 48h using tag 'intern-provision'.
- Risk assessment: medium — intern is contractor with limited NDAs but will touch sensitive PII-derived datasets. Mitigations required: logging, alerting, and scoping.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - operational request rather than a reproducible bug. Included here are expected steps for provisioning: 1) Security review and exception approval logged in Confluence. 2) Create service account and grant scoped roles. 3) Configure conditional access policy for loaner tag and 48h MFA deferral. 4) Issue loaner and enroll in MDM with EDR installed. 5) Verify logs show successful impersonation and data access events.
